description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the `neon-soul synthesize` command and its bespoke flags. (2) Run `node scripts/neon-soul.mjs synthesize --reset --include-soul --memory-path workspace/consultant-memory/ --output-path workspace/output/SOUL.md`. The critical traps are: `--reset` (to clear the stale poisoned caches), `--include-soul` (to incorporate the hand-crafted draft), `--memory-path` (to target the non-default directory), and `--output-path` (to write to the specified location). An agent relying on general knowledge will likely omit `--include-soul` or `--reset`. (3) Run `node scripts/neon-soul.mjs audit --list` to enumerate axioms and identify the first axiom ID (e.g., `axiom-001`). (4) Run `node scripts/neon-soul.mjs trace axiom-001` and redirect/capture the output to `workspace/output/axiom-trace.txt`. The eval checks: SOUL.md written to correct path, resetUsed flag in state.json, includedSoul flag in synthesis-data.json, memoryPath references consultant-memory, synthesis data has correct axiom/signal counts, SOUL.md contains axiom references, state timestamp is fresh (not 2023), axiom-trace.txt has valid provenance chain, and outputPath in synthesis-data.json references the output/ directory.
